component.name: Faugus
component.summary: A simple and lightweight app for running games using UMU-Launcher

ul.li: Play Windows games using Proton
Play Linux native games
Run Windows games directly from the .exe file
Prefix management
Shortcut and Steam shortcut management
Winetricks: A helper tool to easily install dependencies, fonts, DLLs, and tweaks for Wine.
Winecfg: Wine's graphical interface to configure Windows versions, libraries, drivers, and integrations.
MangoHud: Shows an overlay for monitoring FPS, temperatures, CPU/GPU load and more.
Feral GameMode: Tweaks your system to improve performance.
Prefer SDL: May fix controller issues in some games.
Additional Application: An additional application to run with the game, like Cheat Engine, Trainers, Mods...
Lossless Scaling Frame Generation: Create fake frames to increase the framerate.
Proton Manager: Download/Remove popular Proton builds.
Wine Wayland Driver support (Experimental).
HDR Support (Experimental).
Gamescope doesn't work.
Added an option to enable interface navigation sounds. Users can choose from the provided samples or use their own audio files and control the volume.
Reworked the Prevent Sleep option. Now it should work on more systems. The python-dbus dependency was removed because it's no longer needed.
Improved banner transition performance. With this change, scrolling through games in Carousel mode should feel smoother when banners are displayed.
Now the Proton Manager also handles the "Latest" options.
Added an option to remove the icons/covers/banners. Thanks @Alexlee500
Now if a launcher installation fails, the prefix is kept if it's shared with other games/apps.
Added Ubuntu 26.10 PPA build.
Fixed Proton Manager showing versions that haven't been downloaded as if they had been.
Fixed a bug that caused Grid icons and the shortcut icon button to become larger on older GTK versions.
Fixed icons from launchers not being fetched from SteamGridDB on List/Grid modes.
Updated translations.
